definitions.explanation: Money spent for business operations or official purposes, often reimbursable.

examples.japanese: {出張|しゅっちょう}の{経費|けいひ}を{申請|しんせい}する。
examples.english: Submit expenses for a business trip.

examples.japanese: {経費|けいひ}を{削減|さくげん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
タクシー{代|だい}は{経費|けいひ}で{落|お}ちる。
examples.english: The taxi fare can be covered as a business expense.

notes:
{経費|けいひ} is a compound: {経|けい} (manage) + {費|ひ} (expense).

COMMON TYPES:
- {交通費|こうつうひ} (transportation expenses)
- {交際費|こうさいひ} (entertainment expenses)
- {通信費|つうしんひ} (communication costs)
- {消耗品費|しょうもうひんひ} (consumable supplies)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経費|けいひ}で{落|お}ちる/とす (to expense something, to charge as expense)
- {経費|けいひ}を{申請|しんせい}する (to submit expense claim)
- {経費|けいひ}を{削減|さくげん}する (to cut costs)
- {経費|けいひ}{精算|せいさん} (expense settlement/reimbursement)

NOTE:
{経費|けいひ}で{落|お}ちる is a common business expression meaning something can be claimed as a business expense.
